issue.title: Obsidian startup smoke check for plugin rollouts
issue.description:
Package the CDP Obsidian startup check as a reusable script that plugin rollouts run.

Nothing in the bob-cli-a2 rollout (or the bob plugins sync docs) launches a real Obsidian before reporting success, so the 1.60.0 relation-index OOM shipped undetected. Package the ad-hoc CDP check used to verify the fix (launch Obsidian with --remote-debugging-port, hook vault reads pre/post layoutReady, count create replays and non-Markdown reads, assert layoutReady within 30s, plugin version, index ready, zero non-Markdown index entries, heap under ~1.5GB, no new Renderer crash reports) as a reusable script that rollouts run before declaring success.
